Name: Trees as Furniture
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
This a simple furniture mod. It adds the trees of the game as furniture.

﻿I made this because I wanted trees in my farm but I was frustrated with the oak seeds spreading around and growing. As bonus, I got indoor trees as well.

﻿I wanted to add Simple Foliage and Vibrant Pastoral trees as well before posting this mod, but it's been collecting dust on my mod's folder, as I'm currently very busy with other mods. So here it is for now, with Earthy Recolor trees included!  🐱 As soon as I'm finished with Crystal Island I'll come back to this mod!



﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]
[size=3]
﻿[b]1.[/b] Download this mod
﻿ ﻿[b]2[/b]. Drop the folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder
﻿﻿﻿Done, now you have the furniture in your game 🐱[/size]

[url=http:]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/I9kOlI4.png[/img]
[/url]
[list]
[*]All common and special trees (trees that you can grow in your farm—for now there's no trees from the map). 
[*][size=3]Earthy trees from the Earthy Recolor.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can find the catalogue on Robin's for 5000g (or 2000g for the separated recolor catalogue).[/size]
[*][size=3]Seasonal trees (e.g.: Seasonal Pine tree will change with the seasons, indoors and outdoors).[/size]
[*][size=3]Non seasonal trees (e.g.: Pine summer tree that won't change with the seasons).[/size]
[*][size=3]Mossy trees.[/size]
[*][size=3]Special trees (mushroom, green rain, etc).[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
[size=3] ﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/hlehbfb.png[/img]

[/size][b]Configurations:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Vanilla Trees:[/b][/size][size=2] Option to enable or disable vanilla trees. Default is enabled.[/size]
[*][b]Earthy Recolor Trees:[/b] [size=2]Option to enable or disable earthy recolor trees. Default is enabled.[/size]
[*][b]Seasonal and Static Trees:[/b][size=2][b] [/b]Options are Seasonal and Static, Seasonal Only, or Static Only. Default is Seasonal and Static.[/size]
[*][b]Catalogues for each recolor:[/b] [size=2]Have all trees (earthy, vanilla, etc.) in a single catalogue, or have each recolor have their own. Options are Separated and Combined. Default is Separated.[/size]
[*][b]Combined Catalogues Price[/b][size=2] and [/size][b]Separated Catalogues Price: [/b][size=2]Changes the price of the catalogues. Default is 5000 and 2000 respectively. [/size]
[*][b][size=3]Disable trees individually: [/size][/b][size=2]Disable certain trees (e.g.: disable palm trees furniture if you don't like them and they won't show on the catalogue/in game). [/size]
[/list][size=2]
﻿Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Mod[/url]﻿ to change these options.


[/size] ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ANQ15K.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Adding trees from the maps![/size]
[*][size=3]Adding Vibrant Pastoral Recolor and Simple Foliage.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
I won't be adding these so soon for now though, as I'm currently focused on my other mod, Crystal Island ^^



﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/vvmTMha.png[/img]
